# QuizDeck v0.2.0 — Bilingual release

## Highlights

- Complete Simplified Chinese and English interface with follow-system and saved language preferences.
- Chinese-default and English-default Android APKs built from the same source; both can switch language in Settings.
- English Excel headers, question types, option labels, answer phrases, and true/false values.
- Localized AI intent confirmation, batch-classification prompts, result summaries, and actionable errors.
- Web preview credentials now use session storage and the legacy persistent entry is cleared.

## Verification

- Web production build and mobile production bundle.
- 69 automated tests and ESLint with zero warnings.
- Chinese and English Android debug APK assembly with JDK 21 and Android SDK 36.
- Narrow-screen review for Chinese and English interface text.
- Repository, Git history, and APK content scans for credentials and non-public content.

## Notes

The included demo bank is original, generic, bilingual, and permanently removable. Model access remains bring-your-own-endpoint and bring-your-own-key. Debug APKs are intended for testing; a production distribution should be signed by the maintainer and published with checksums.
